_comment: Colour of every material name used in public/models/*.glb. Colours are the filament colours stored in 'Factory Speghetti AMS.3mf' (Metadata/project_settings.config, filament_colour; 'filament' is the 1-based slot number). The converter warns if the file's colour for that slot no longer matches. 'player' is tinted at runtime with the owner's colour; its colour here is a neutral placeholder (the file's slot 4 colour is #71D0FF). The four materials (ore, plate, sphere, tesseract) take colour and surface from src/table/materialColors.ts, the one source of truth the game's 2D icons also read: the print file's slot colours for them (filaments 8, 7, 6, 5) are all very light and do not darken with value as the printed pieces do. icon-green, lime-green and yellow-green keep the file's slot colours (yellow-green: the starting-player piece).
